title: Empty Split results consume the non-empty window budget
claim: The StringWindows loop stops after 32 output positions, including empty strings, so the first non-empty tainted Split result at index 32 is never derived and appears clean despite being below the 32 non-empty-window cap.
repro_command: Copy .omo/review/evidence/prop-string-exact/zz_review_splitranges_test.go into an isolated copy's iast/propagation/ directory, then run GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -timeout 5m -count=1 -run '^TestReviewStringsSplitTaintedFirstNonEmptyAfterEmptyPrefix$' -v ./iast/propagation
